title: Prime Video free trial UK: 30 days free and what's on in December 2026
seoTitle: Prime Video Free Trial UK 2026: 30 Days + What's On
description: The 30-day Prime Video free trial in the UK: what it costs after, the ad-free add-on, and the shows, films and sport coming in December 2026.
intro:
**Short answer: in the UK you get Prime Video by starting Amazon's 30-day Prime free trial, which includes Prime Video, free delivery and the other Prime extras. After 30 days it costs £8.99 a month or £95 a year unless you cancel. Start it today (25 November) and it runs to about 25 December, so it covers Black Friday, Cyber Monday, your Christmas deliveries and most of December's new releases.**

Prime Video in the UK shows adverts unless you pay £2.99 a month extra for ad-free viewing. Trial and prices were last checked on 25 November 2026. Device prices below are Amazon UK's Black Friday Week prices, as reported by TechRadar on 24 and 25 November 2026.

body:
## How the Prime Video free trial works in the UK

In the UK, Prime Video comes with Amazon Prime, so the usual route is the **Prime free trial**:

- It lasts **30 days** and you need a payment card on file.
- You get full Prime: Prime Video, fast free delivery, Amazon Music (the Prime version), Prime Reading and free games on Luna.
- After 30 days it rolls on to **£8.99 a month**, or **£95 a year** if you switch to annual (about £12.88 cheaper than paying monthly for a year).
- Amazon decides who's eligible. It's mainly for people who haven't had Prime recently, so if you've had a trial in the last year you may not see one.

Amazon also sells a Prime Video membership on its own, without the delivery benefits. Check the price on the sign-up page if you only want to stream; for most households the full Prime trial is the better deal, because it's free for the first month either way.

**Students and anyone aged 18 to 24** should start with Prime Student instead: six months free, then half price. See our [Prime Student guide](/guides/prime-student-uk/).

## Adverts, and what ad-free costs

Since 2024, Prime Video in the UK has shown a few adverts during films and shows. If that bothers you, Amazon charges **£2.99 a month** to remove them. You can add or drop it at any time from your Prime Video settings, so one option is to try the trial with adverts first and only pay if they annoy you.

## When to start your trial

If you start the trial today, 25 November, it ends around 25 December. That gives you:

1. Amazon's Black Friday Week (to 30 November), with free fast delivery on Prime items. See our [Prime Black Friday guide](/guides/amazon-prime-free-trial-black-friday-2026/) for how much Prime matters for the deals.
2. Free delivery on Christmas orders right up to Amazon's last delivery dates.
3. Most of December's new releases (below).

If you mainly want to binge Christmas films, starting in early December stretches the trial into the new year. You'd miss free Black Friday delivery, though.

## What's on Prime Video in December 2026

From Amazon's December 2026 listings:

- **The Man With The Bag** (2 December): a new Christmas film, an Amazon original.
- **Quiz from God** (4 December): a new Prime original drama.
- **The Devil's Hour series 3** (4 December): the return of the British thriller.
- **Sacred Jewel** (5 December): a new original series.
- **Love Actually** (from 5 December): back in time for Christmas.
- **Maxton Hall: The World Between Us series 3** (9 December).
- **Already streaming:** Arthur Christmas, How the Grinch Stole Christmas, Christmas Karma and Your Christmas or Mine 2.
- **Live sport:** a Champions League league-phase match on 8 December, the NBA Cup Final on 11 December, and NBA on Prime games on 13, 27 and 31 December.

Some new films, such as Klara and The Sun and Clayface, are rent or buy only, so they cost extra even with Prime.

## What you need to watch it

Prime Video works on most smart TVs, phones, tablets, games consoles and laptops, so you may need nothing extra. A streaming stick is worth it if your TV's apps are slow or missing:

- **Older or HD TV:** the Fire TV Stick HD at £17.99.
- **Most 4K TVs:** the Fire TV Stick 4K at £31.99, our pick.
- **Patchy Wi-Fi, or you want the fastest menus:** the 4K Max at £46.99.

For more, see our [Fire TV Stick deals guide](/guides/fire-tv-stick-deals-uk/) and [TV Black Friday deals](/guides/tv-black-friday-deals-2026/), or browse [every Black Friday 2026 guide](/black-friday/).

## How to cancel the trial

Go to **Your Account → Prime Membership → Manage → Update, cancel and more**, then end your membership. If you signed up through Google Play on Android, cancel there instead. Do it a day or two before the 30 days are up. You can usually keep watching until the trial runs out.

## FAQs

### Is there a Prime Video free trial in the UK?

Yes. Amazon's 30-day Prime free trial includes Prime Video. After that it's £8.99 a month or £95 a year unless you cancel.

### How much is Prime Video after the free trial?

Full Prime is £8.99 a month or £95 a year, and ad-free viewing is £2.99 a month on top. Amazon also sells Prime Video on its own; its price is shown on the sign-up page.

### Can I get the Prime Video free trial twice?

Usually not straight away. Amazon offers the trial mainly to people who haven't had Prime recently. Some former members are offered it again after about a year.

### Does the Prime Video free trial have adverts?

Yes. The standard plan includes a few adverts. You can add ad-free viewing for £2.99 a month during the trial or after.

### What's new on Prime Video in December 2026?

The Man With The Bag (2 December), Quiz from God and The Devil's Hour series 3 (4 December), Sacred Jewel and Love Actually (5 December), Maxton Hall series 3 (9 December), plus Champions League and NBA games.
